rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Contributes the AVT, an original taxonomy of agentic security vulnerability classes.
rationale.ai-review: Proposes LLM-assisted semantic analysis and a secondary AI auditor for reasoning.
rationale.org-governance: CGI connects the pipeline to GRC platforms via an Agentic Risk Register.
rationale.provenance-auditability: PCV records context hashes and reasoning traces for human retrospective audit.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Generates audit evidence explicitly mapped to ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST RMF.
rationale.rules-based-checks: UAST's BDA layer dynamically executes dependencies in simulated production sandboxes.
rationale.metrics: Defines the ARSM metric to measure security risk of agentic vulnerabilities.
rationale.risk-security: Clause fired: contributes a mitigation (UAST) and defines a metric (ARSM).
